name: TOWER
description: TOWER is a novel evaluation metric that incorporates human-judged importance into assessing large language models' ability to follow complex human-written instructions. It uses tree-based representations to capture the varying importance of instruction aspects and provides a more nuanced evaluation compared to existing LLM-based judges.
reputation: A niche but influential recent benchmark paper; it is cited mainly in work on instruction-following evaluation rather than being a long-established community standard.
notes: Releases tree-based annotations of the InFoBench dataset and evaluation code.
